create_auto_processor: create an AutoProcessor instance from a pretrained model name or path using AutoProcessor.from_pretrained
register_processor_class: register a new processor class for a model config class using AutoProcessor.register
lookup_processor_class_by_name: look up a processor class by its name string using processor_class_from_name
build_processor_mapping: build a lazy processor mapping from model config types to processor class names using PROCESSOR_MAPPING
fallback_to_tokenizer_processor: fallback to AutoTokenizer or AutoImageProcessor when no AutoProcessor class is found for a model
